name: @meko/bootstrap-theme
description: MeKo Bootstrap 5 theme (Primary #00afaa, Open Sans). Variant A (full build) & Variant B (variables-only).

scripts.build: sass --load-path=./node_modules src/meko_theme.scss dist/bootstrap-meko.css --no-source-map && postcss dist/bootstrap-meko.css -o dist/bootstrap-meko.min.css && mkdir -p public && cp dist/bootstrap-meko.min.css public/bootstrap-meko.min.css
